entries.description: Ran this as a baseline session rather than as E2 session 2. It closes a gap the E2 session recorded against itself, but the schedule assigns session 2 to E2-human; consuming that slot would have taken the orchestrator's arm and contaminated the comparison. The arm assignment is frozen and is not mine to spend.

Refused to claim minimality. Depth 3 is untouched, so the honest statement is 'witness at depth 4, none below depth 3'. Wrote the precise obstruction into the file: the negation gadget makes depth-<=2 trees unbounded on the negative axis, so the constant bound must become linear and the threshold N becomes necessary, not cosmetic.
